stage_5.name: 上升推进
stage_5.observable_claim: after frozen Stage-4 acceptance, the path has established a material positive extension while the provisional structural support candidate has not been broken
non_claims: Stage 5 is not a top-1 replacement for a local pullback state
maximum future extension is not an input at T

stage_6.name: 回踩测试
stage_6.observable_claim: an established advancing background is undergoing a bounded current drawdown from its causal running peak while the provisional structural support candidate remains intact
non_claims: a pullback is not structural failure
future rebound success is not known
support integrity cannot be inferred from missing data

frozen_measurements.advance_extension: causal running maximum close / Stage-4 acceptance close - 1
frozen_measurements.current_drawdown: current close / causal running maximum close - 1
frozen_measurements.provisional_support_integrity: current close has not crossed below the episode initial pre-T low support candidate

constraints: Stage-5 background may remain true while Stage-6 local pullback is true
Stage-7 is not emitted by this experiment

primary_questions: is an advancing background established at T
is there a bounded pullback at T while the same background remains valid

blocked_states.7: preserved as a distinct stage code; requires a T-only recovery/rebuild measurement after deeper damage because depth alone is not repair
blocked_states.10: preserved as a distinct stage code; requires persistent same-support failure / failed reclaim and explicit support-role evidence rather than one crossing
blocked_states.11: preserved as a distinct stage code; requires prior Stage-10-grade failure plus a rebound while the same failed support remains unreclaimed

claim_limits: This experiment does not produce a qualified or official Stage-5/6 label.
The 27-value grid is result-aware development design derived from the consumed development profile and cannot be called confirmatory evidence.
2022-2024 cannot be reused as a fresh holdout and 2025 remains unopened/unselected.
Continuous Facts remain a mandatory same-information baseline for any later discrete-stage comparison.
